gloss: to approach; to lobby; to urge

definitions.gloss: to approach; to lobby; to urge
definitions.explanation: To act on a person or an organization in order to get them to do something: to press the government, appeal to the public, or persuade a colleague. The one approached takes に.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{働|はたら}きかける。
⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{働|はたら}きかけた。
examples.english: We urged the city to improve the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧よう{鉄道会社|てつどうがいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{働|はたら}きかけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Residents are working together to press the railway company to put a lift in the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{働|はたら}きかける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine acts directly on the brain, so it takes effect quickly.

notes:
Ichidan: {働|はたら}きかける, {働|はたら}きかけた. The target takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧; the request is a noun with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ or a clause with よう(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). Also used of things that act on the body or mind (a drug, music). The noun is ⟦{働|はたら}きかけ→働きかけ：11527_hatarakikake⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{働|はたら}きかける: to lobby the government
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{働|はたら}きかける: to make active approaches
- ⟦{働|はたら}きかけ→働きかけ：11527_hatarakikake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}める→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧: to step up pressure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{呼|よ}びかける→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧: to call on, to appeal — addresses many people at once
- ⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧: to urge, to prompt — a single nudge
